name: github-agent-skills
description: Eleven evidence-based GitHub workflows for inspection and local preparation with human authorisation for remote actions.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect GitHub evidence and prepare local changes
interface.longDescription: Eleven workflows for repository audits, README editing, profile curation, release preparation, issue drafting, issue triage, breaking a specification into issues, issue implementation, branch review, pull request descriptions and reviewing open pull requests. Remote actions need explicit human authorisation.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this repository and prepare an evidence-based local release handoff.
